```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Add a nice ordinal to a date (e.g. Feb 23rd, 2026)
format_date_ordinal <- function(d) {
  day <- as.integer(format(d, "%d"))
  suffix <- if (day %in% c(11, 12, 13)) {
    "th"
  } else {
    switch(as.character(day %% 10), "1" = "st", "2" = "nd", "3" = "rd", "th")
  }
  paste0(format(d, "%b. "), day, suffix, format(d, ", %Y"))
}

# Transform numbers into abbreviated amounts
# 100 becomes 100, 1000 becomes 1K, 1000000 becomes $1M, etc.
label_comma_short <- function(x) {
  sapply(
    x,
    function(val) {
      if (is.na(val)) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }

      abs_val <- abs(val)
      sign_str <- ifelse(val < 0, "-", "")
      if (abs_val >= 1e12) {
        paste0(sign_str, round(abs_val / 1e12, 0), "T")
      } else if (abs_val >= 1e9) {
        paste0(sign_str, round(abs_val / 1e9, 0), "B")
      } else if (abs_val >= 1e6) {
        paste0(sign_str, round(abs_val / 1e6, 0), "M")
      } else if (abs_val >= 1e3) {
        paste0(sign_str, round(abs_val / 1e3, 0), "K")
      } else {
        paste0(sign_str, formatC(abs_val, format = "f", digits = 0))
      }
    },
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r load_data}
DATA_DIR <- "data/output"
DATA_DATE <- as.Date("2026-03-29")

# Load each parquet file in data/output/, stripping the date prefix to
# create the dataframe name (e.g. 2026_02_18_payer_files_mar.parquet
# becomes payer_files_mar).
payer_files <- list.files(
  DATA_DIR,
  pattern = paste0("^", gsub("-", "_", DATA_DATE), ".*\\.parquet$"),
  full.names = TRUE
)
for (path in payer_files) {
  name <- sub(
    "^\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_",
    "",
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
  )
  assign(
    name,
    read_parquet(path) |>
      # Convert payer_id to char and grab the first number as a version. Most
      # have a mix of semver and string versions (e.g. 1.0.0, v1, 1.0), so this
      # correctly grabs just the "1" for version
      mutate(across(any_of("payer_id"), \(x) as.character(x))) |>
      mutate(across(
        any_of("version"),
        \(x) str_extract(version, "\\d+"),
        .names = "{.col}_parsed"
      ))
  )
}

# Build a payer name lookup table w/ covered lives. Add a boolean of top 50
# payers for use between plots
payer_names <- payer_files_dec |>
  distinct(payer_id, payer_name) |>
  group_by(payer_id) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(payer_lives, by = c("payer_id" = "tq_payer_payer_id")) |>
  select(payer_id, payer_name, payer_lives = lives) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = str_replace_all(payer_name, "Blue Cross Blue Shield", "BCBS"),
    payer_name = replace_values(
      payer_name,
      "BCBS of Pennsylvania (Capital Blue Cross)" ~
        "BCBS of Pennsylvania (CBC)",
      "Healthcare Management Administrators (HMA)" ~ "HMA",
      "Ventura County Health Care Plan (VCHCP)" ~ "VCHCP",
      "Innovation Health Insurance Company" ~ "Innovation"
    ),
    # Fill covered lives for United and Aetna TPAs
    payer_lives = case_when(
      payer_id == "861" ~ payer_lives[payer_id == "7"],
      payer_id == "953" ~ payer_lives[payer_id == "643"],
      .default = payer_lives
    )
  )

top_n_payer_ids <- payer_names |>
  slice_max(payer_lives, n = 46) |>
  pull(payer_id) |>
  c("108", "978", "947", "111")

# Grab the unique network names + count per data source/file
network_names_per_file_mar <- payer_files_mar |>
  select(payer_id, data_source_name) |>
  left_join(network_names_mar, by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")) |>
  group_by(payer_id, data_source_name) |>
  summarize(
    nn_unique_names_lst_mar = list(unique(str_trim(flatten_chr(
      network_names
    )))),
    nn_unique_names_cnt_mar = map_int(nn_unique_names_lst_mar, \(x) length(x))
  )

# Join various payer datasets to make our main working table. One row per payer.
# First we grab the count of data source names for each month, plus the count
# of different TiC schema versions
payer_df <- payer_files_dec |>
  distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, version_parsed) |>
  summarize(
    n_dsn_dec = n(),
    n_dsn_v1_dec = sum(version_parsed == 1),
    n_dsn_v2_dec = sum(version_parsed == 2),
    .by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    payer_files_mar |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, version_parsed) |>
      summarize(
        n_dsn_mar = n(),
        n_dsn_v1_mar = sum(version_parsed == 1),
        n_dsn_v2_mar = sum(version_parsed == 2),
        .by = "payer_id"
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach expected number of INR files for each month, where "expected" means
  # files that will eventually be ingested / processed. We assume this number
  # doesn't change within a given month (i.e. once files are posted for March,
  # the payer won't come back and post more files)
  left_join(
    parsing_status_dec |>
      filter(
        !is_skipped,
        !is_broken,
        !has_error,
        schema == "in-network-rates"
      ) |>
      summarize(num_files_expected_dec = n(), .by = "payer_id"),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    parsing_status_mar |>
      filter(
        !is_skipped,
        !is_broken,
        !has_error,
        schema == "in-network-rates"
      ) |>
      summarize(num_files_expected_mar = n(), .by = "payer_id"),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach metadata (size, num external reference files) for parsed files.
  # Here we only take data for files successfully ingested (no size, ref data
  # exists for parsing or errored files)
  left_join(
    parsing_status_dec |>
      filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_files_parsed_dec = n(),
        tot_file_bytes_dec = sum(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_file_bytes_dec = mean(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    parsing_status_mar |>
      filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_files_parsed_mar = n(),
        tot_file_bytes_mar = sum(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_file_bytes_mar = mean(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Diff expected vs parsed files, and convert raw byte values to nice strings
  mutate(
    diff_expected_files = num_files_expected_mar - num_files_expected_dec,
    diff_parsed_files = num_files_parsed_mar - num_files_parsed_dec,
    diff_bytes = tot_file_bytes_mar - tot_file_bytes_dec,
    diff_avg_bytes = avg_file_bytes_mar - avg_file_bytes_dec,
    across(
      contains("bytes"),
      \(x) {
        case_when(
        abs(x) >= 1099511627776 ~ paste(round(x / 1099511627776.0, 1), "TB"),
        abs(x) >= 1073741824 ~ paste(round(x / 1073741824.0, 1), "GB"),
        abs(x) >= 1048576 ~ paste(round(x / 1048576.0, 1), "MB"),
        abs(x) >= 1024 ~ paste(round(x / 1024.0, 1), "KB"),
        abs(x) >= 0 ~ paste(round(x / 1.0, 1), "B")
      )
      },
      .names = "{.col}_parsed"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  relocate(payer_id, payer_name, payer_lives) |>
  # Attach network_name stats per payer, aggregating from the per payer + data
  # source name level dataframe
  left_join(
    network_names_per_file_mar |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        nn_pct_of_posted = mean(
          nn_unique_names_cnt_mar > 0,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        nn_unique_names_lst_mar = list(unique(flatten_chr(
          nn_unique_names_lst_mar
        ))),
        nn_avg_unique_names_per_file = mean(
          nn_unique_names_cnt_mar[nn_unique_names_cnt_mar != 0],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        nn_avg_unique_names_per_file = case_when(
          is.nan(nn_avg_unique_names_per_file) ~ NA,
          .default = nn_avg_unique_names_per_file
        ),
        nn_unique_names_cnt_mar = map_int(nn_unique_names_lst_mar, length)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach provider_group mode stats (i.e. inline, external, internal provider
  # groups). External vs internal provider group (PG) references aren't
  # differentiated in the INR schema itself. Instead, we get the number of
  # external PGs by seeing if a given data source name had a "location file"
  # associated with it when parsing
  left_join(
    provider_mode_dec |>
      left_join(
        parsing_status_dec |>
          filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
          select(payer_id, data_source_name, expected_location_files),
        by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")
      ) |>
      mutate(
        provider_mode = case_when(
          expected_location_files > 0 ~ "external",
          provider_mode == "reference" ~ "internal",
          .default = provider_mode
        )
      ) |>
      # Drop payers with multiple ref types per file (there are only a few)
      arrange(desc(provider_mode)) |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_dsn_pg_inline_dec = sum(provider_mode == "inline"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_dec = sum(provider_mode == "external"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_int_dec = sum(provider_mode == "internal")
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    provider_mode_mar |>
      left_join(
        parsing_status_mar |>
          filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
          select(payer_id, data_source_name, expected_location_files),
        by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")
      ) |>
      mutate(
        provider_mode = case_when(
          expected_location_files > 0 ~ "external",
          provider_mode == "reference" ~ "internal",
          .default = provider_mode
        )
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(provider_mode)) |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_dsn_pg_inline_mar = sum(provider_mode == "inline"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_mar = sum(provider_mode == "external"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_int_mar = sum(provider_mode == "internal")
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  relocate(starts_with("num_dsn_pg"), .after = everything()) |>
  relocate(starts_with("num_files"), .after = n_dsn_v2_mar) |>
  relocate(starts_with("tot_file"), .after = num_files_parsed_mar) |>
  relocate(starts_with("diff"), .after = avg_file_bytes_mar_parsed)
```

```{r tbl_summary_by_payer}
payer_summ_df <- payer_df |>
  transmute(
    payer_id,
    `Payer name` = payer_name,
    `Has V2 version string` = (n_dsn_v2_mar / n_dsn_mar) * 100,
    `Uses internal provider groups` = (num_dsn_pg_ref_int_mar / n_dsn_mar) *
      100,
    `Added network_name` = nn_pct_of_posted * 100
  ) |>
  left_join(
    ein_fill_rate_mar |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        n_ein_records = sum(n_ein_records),
        n_with_business_name = sum(n_with_business_name)
      ) |>
      transmute(
        payer_id,
        `Added business_name` = (n_with_business_name / n_ein_records) * 100
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(`Payer name`)

payer_summ_df |>
  write_csv("data/publish/tbl_summ_by_payer.csv", na = "")
```

```{r tbl_summary_overall}
payer_summ_df |>
  summarize(
    `Payer group` = "All payers",
    across(
      `Has V2 version string`:`Added business_name`,
      \(x) mean(x >= 90.0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    payer_summ_df |>
      filter(payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids) |>
      summarize(
        `Payer group` = "Top 50 payers",
        across(
          `Has V2 version string`:`Added business_name`,
          \(x) mean(x >= 90.0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
        )
      )
  ) |>
  write_csv("data/publish/tbl_summ_overall.csv")
```

# Version plots

```{r plt_version_adoption_overall}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5

version_adoption_df <- payer_df |>
  mutate(
    n_dsn_v1_dec = replace_values(n_dsn_v1_dec, NA ~ n_dsn_dec),
    across(
      c(n_dsn_v2_dec, n_dsn_v1_mar, n_dsn_v2_mar),
      \(x) replace_values(x, NA ~ 0)
    )
  ) |>
  summarize(
    v1_dec = sum(n_dsn_v1_dec & !n_dsn_v2_dec, na.rm = TRUE),
    v2_dec = sum(n_dsn_v2_dec & !n_dsn_v1_dec, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_v2_dec = sum(n_dsn_v1_dec & n_dsn_v2_dec, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_mar = sum(n_dsn_v1_mar & !n_dsn_v2_mar, na.rm = TRUE),
    v2_mar = sum(n_dsn_v2_mar & !n_dsn_v1_mar, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_v2_mar = sum(n_dsn_v1_mar & n_dsn_v2_mar, na.rm = TRUE),
    vmissing_dec = n() - v1_dec - v2_dec - v1_v2_dec,
    vmissing_mar = n() - v1_mar - v2_mar - v1_v2_mar,
    across(starts_with("v"), \(x) x / n(), .names = "pct_{.col}")
  ) |>
  rename_with(\(x) paste0("cnt_", x), starts_with("v")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("stat", "version", "month"),
    names_pattern = "(pct|cnt)_(v.*)_(dec|mar)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  filter_out(version == "vmissing" & month == "dec") |>
  mutate(
    version = recode_values(
      version,
      "v1" ~ "All V1<br>files",
      "v1_v2" ~ "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)",
      "v2" ~ "All V2<br>files",
      "vmissing" ~ "Missing ver.<br>or Mar. files"
    ),
    month = recode_values(
      month,
      "dec" ~ "December 2025",
      "mar" ~ "March 2026"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "stat", values_from = "value") |>
  mutate(
    version = factor(
      version,
      levels = c(
        "All V1<br>files",
        "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)",
        "All V2<br>files",
        "Missing ver.<br>or Mar. files"
      )
    ),
    label = paste0(
      cnt,
      "<br>",
      "<span style='font-size:12px;color:grey30'>(",
      label_percent()(pct),
      ")</span>"
    )
  )

ggplot(version_adoption_df) +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = cnt, x = version, fill = version)
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(y = cnt, x = version, label = label),
    nudge_y = 10,
    size = 4.5,
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "All V1<br>files" = "#fc8d62",
      "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)" = "#8da0cb",
      "All V2<br>files" = "#66c2a5",
      "Missing ver.<br>or Mar. files" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Overall TiC 2.0 schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE)
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Of ",
      version_adoption_df |>
        filter(
          month == "March 2026",
          version != "Missing ver.<br>or Mar. files"
        ) |>
        summarize(n = sum(cnt)) |>
        pull(n),
      " payers with Mar. files, just ",
      version_adoption_df |>
        filter(
          month == "March 2026",
          version == "All V2<br>files"
        ) |>
        summarize(n = sum(cnt)) |>
        pull(n),
      " have fully adopted the ",
      "TiC 2.0 schema"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Version is self-reported by payers and may not actually reflect ",
      "file changes<br>Version is the first digit of any posted schema ",
      "version e.g. 1.0.0 and v1.6.0 equal V1, 2.0.0 and V2.0.0 equal V2, etc."
    ),
    x = "",
    y = "Count of payers"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(month), strip.position = "bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -26)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -26),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 4)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(t = -8),
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    )
  )
```

```{r plt_version_adoption_by_payer}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

payer_df |>
  filter(payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids) |>
  mutate(
    n_dsn_mar = pmin(replace_values(n_dsn_mar, NA ~ 0), num_files_expected_mar),
    n_dsn_v1_mar = replace_values(n_dsn_v1_mar, NA ~ n_dsn_mar),
    n_dsn_v2_mar = replace_values(n_dsn_v2_mar, NA ~ 0),
    num_files_expected_mar = replace_values(
      num_files_expected_mar,
      NA ~ num_files_expected_dec
    ),
    n_dsn_missing_mar = num_files_expected_mar - (n_dsn_v1_mar + n_dsn_v2_mar)
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_id,
    payer_name,
    payer_lives,
    starts_with("n_dsn_v"),
    starts_with("n_dsn_m"),
    starts_with("num_files_exp")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("n_dsn"),
    names_to = c("version", "month"),
    values_to = "count",
    names_pattern = "n_dsn_(missing|v1|v2)_(dec|mar)"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct = count /
      ifelse(
        month == "dec",
        num_files_expected_dec,
        num_files_expected_mar
      ),
    version = fct_rev(factor(
      recode_values(
        version,
        "v1" ~ "V1",
        "v2" ~ "V2",
        "missing" ~ "Missing version"
      ),
      levels = c("V2", "V1", "Missing version")
    ))
  ) |>
  filter(month != "dec") |>
  mutate(
    v2_pct = pct[version == "V2"],
    v1_pct = pct[version == "V1"],
    .by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(v2_pct), desc(v1_pct)) |>
  mutate(payer_name = fct_rev(fct_reorder(payer_name, row_number()))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = payer_name, x = pct, fill = version),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "V1" = "#fc8d62",
      "V2" = "#66c2a5",
      "Missing version" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "", reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Payer-level TiC 2.0 schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE)
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Most of the top 50 payers (by national covered lives) ",
      "are still transitioning to TiC 2.0"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Version is self-reported by payers and may not actually reflect ",
      "file changes"
    ),
    y = "",
    x = "Percent of March payer files"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -140)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -140),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12, b = 4, r = -15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
```

```{r plt_pg_overall}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5

payer_df |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c("n_dsn_dec", "n_dsn_mar") | starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
      \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
    names_to = c("ref_type", "month"),
    names_pattern = "num_dsn_pg_(.*)_(dec|mar)",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(pct = count / ifelse(month == "dec", n_dsn_dec, n_dsn_mar)) |>
  mutate(
    ref_type = factor(
      paste0(ref_type, "-", month),
      levels = c(
        "inline-dec",
        "ref_ext-dec",
        "ref_int-dec",
        "inline-mar",
        "ref_ext-mar",
        "ref_int-mar"
      )
    ),
    ref_type_fct = fct_relabel(
      ref_type,
      \(x) {
        case_when(
          ref_type == "inline-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**Inline<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_ext-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**External<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_int-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**Internal<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "inline-mar" ~ paste0(
            "**Inline<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(banned in 2.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_ext-mar" ~ paste0(
            "**External<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(banned in 2.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_int-mar" ~ paste0(
            "**Internal<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(required in 2.0)</span>"
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    month = recode_values(
      month,
      "dec" ~ "December 2025",
      "mar" ~ "March 2026"
    ),
    label = label_percent()(pct)
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = pct, x = ref_type_fct, fill = ref_type)
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(y = pct, x = ref_type_fct, label = label),
    nudge_y = 0.025,
    size = 4.5,
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +

    values = c(
      "inline-dec" = "#fc8d62",

      "ref_int-dec" = "#66c2a5",
      "inline-mar" = "#fc8d62",
      "ref_ext-mar" = "#8da0cb",
      "ref_int-mar" = "#66c2a5"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Provider reference schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE)
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Most payers were already using the internal ",
      "provider groups required in TiC 2.0"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files"
    ),
    x = "",
    y = "Percent of March payer files"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(

    ),

      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -30),

    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,

    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),

    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
```

```{r plt_pg_by_payer}
payer_df |>

    ),

      pick(matches("num_dsn_pg_.*_mar")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("num_dsn_pg") & ends_with("dec"),
      \(x) x / num_files_expected_dec
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("num_dsn_pg") & ends_with("mar"),
      \(x) x / num_files_expected_mar
    ),
    ref_int_diff = num_dsn_pg_ref_int_mar - num_dsn_pg_ref_int_dec
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_id,
    payer_name,
    payer_lives,
    starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),

  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
```

```{r tbl_nn_cnt_per_file_top}
# Grab the most common network name by payer + count of that name across all
# files from that payer
network_names_per_file_mar |>
  unnest(cols = nn_unique_names_lst_mar) |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(payer_id, nn_unique_names_lst_mar) |>
  arrange(payer_id, desc(n)) |>
  filter(row_number() <= 5, .by = payer_id) |>
  summarize(
    net_names = paste(nn_unique_names_lst_mar, collapse = ", "),
    .by = c("payer_id")
  ) |>
  right_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  left_join(
    payer_df |>
      select(payer_id, nn_unique_names_cnt_mar),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = str_trunc(payer_name, 40),
    nn_unique_names_cnt_mar = replace_na(nn_unique_names_cnt_mar, 0),
    net_names = replace_na(net_names, "No networks posted")
  ) |>
  arrange(payer_name) |>
  select(
    `Payer name` = payer_name,
    `# of unique net. names` = nn_unique_names_cnt_mar,
    `Top 5 most common network names by file count` = net_names
  ) |>
  write_csv("data/publish/tbl_nn_cnt_top.csv")
```

# File change plots

---

```{r plt_file_size_changes}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 11

plt_file_sizes_df <- payer_df |>
  mutate(
    pct_posted = n_dsn_mar / num_files_expected_mar
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_diff_bytes = (tot_file_bytes_mar - tot_file_bytes_dec) /
      tot_file_bytes_dec,
    pct_diff_files = (num_files_expected_mar - num_files_expected_dec) /
      num_files_expected_dec,
    pct_diff_avg = (avg_file_bytes_mar - avg_file_bytes_dec) /
      avg_file_bytes_dec,
    pg_type = case_when(
      ((num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_dec / n_dsn_dec) -
         (num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_mar / n_dsn_mar)) >= 0.15 ~ "ext_to_int",
      ((num_dsn_pg_inline_dec / n_dsn_dec) -
         (num_dsn_pg_inline_mar / n_dsn_mar)) >= 0.15 ~ "inl_to_int",
      .default = "same"
    ),
    pg_type = factor(
      pg_type,
      levels = c(
        "ext_to_int",
        "inl_to_int",
        "same"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids,
    pct_posted >= 0.95
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_name,
    pct_diff_bytes,
    diff_bytes_parsed,
    diff_bytes,
    pct_diff_files,
    diff_expected_files,
    pct_diff_avg,
    diff_avg_bytes_parsed,
    pg_type
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = replace_values(
      payer_name,
      "BCBS of Pennsylvania (Independence)" ~ "BCBS of Penn. (Independence)"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "diff_type",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diff = case_when(
      diff_type == "pct_diff_bytes" ~ diff_bytes_parsed,
      diff_type == "pct_diff_avg" ~ diff_avg_bytes_parsed,
      .default = label_comma()(diff_expected_files)
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diff_type = recode_values(
      diff_type,
      "pct_diff_bytes" ~ "% change in total file size",
      "pct_diff_files" ~ "% change in total file count",
      "pct_diff_avg" ~ "% change in avg. file size"
    ),
    diff_type = factor(
      diff_type,
      levels = c(
        "% change in total file size",
        "% change in total file count",
        "% change in avg. file size"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_label = paste0(
      case_when(
        pct > 1 ~ "<span style='color:#fc8d62;font-size:20px'>**→**</span> +",
        pct > 0 ~ "+",
        NA ~ "Missing",
        .default = ""
      ),
      diff
    ),
    pct = pmin(pct, 1),
    pct = case_when(
      str_detect(payer_name, "Geisinger") ~ pct + 0.03,
      str_detect(payer_name, "SelectHealth") ~ pct + 0.02,
      str_detect(payer_name, "Harvard Pilgrim") ~ pct + 0.01,
      .default = pct
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_sort = pct[diff_type == "% change in total file size"],
    .by = payer_name
  ) |>
  filter(
    diff_type %in%
      c(
        "% change in total file size",
        "% change in total file count"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = fct_reorder(payer_name, pct_sort),
    pct = pmin(pct, 1)
  )

plt_file_sizes_df |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      fill = pct > 0
    ),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    data = tibble(
      "diff_type" = unique(plt_file_sizes_df$diff_type)[1],
      "pg_type" = unique(plt_file_sizes_df$pg_type),
      "txt" = c(
        "Payers that made no major change to provider references*",
        "Payers that switched from external references to internal references",
        "Payers that switched from inline references to internal references"
      ),
      "pos" = c(29.5, 6.5, 15.5)
    ),
    aes(
      x = -1.65,
      y = pos,
      label = txt,
    ),
    vjust = 0,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey10",
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      label = pct_label,
      hjust = case_when(
        pct == 1 ~ 0.1,
        pct < 0 ~ 1.05,
        .default = -0.05
      )
    ),
    size = 3,
    color = "grey30",
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(diff_type),
    rows = vars(pg_type),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    switch = "both"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = NULL,
    labels = label_percent(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.35, 0.3)),
    breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "#66c2a5",
      "TRUE" = "#fc8d62"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Changes to provider references had a big impact on payer file sizes"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Switching from inline to internal refs decreased file sizes, ",
      "while moving external refs into files increased file sizes"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "\\* A \"major\" change here means a payer switched at least 15 percent ",
      " of their files to internal references. ",
      "Small and unrelated (e.g. adding network_name) changes
      can still affect file size"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 22,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -136)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15.5,
      margin = margin(b = 32, l = -136),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(r = 2),
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      hjust = c(0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3)
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(r = -4)
    ),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(-0.4, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      vjust = 0,
      angle = 0
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )
```

# EIN/TIN business name plots

---

```{r plt_ein_by_payer}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

ein_fill_rate_mar |>
  group_by(payer_id) |>
  summarize(
    n_ein_records = sum(n_ein_records),
    n_with_business_name = sum(n_with_business_name)
  ) |>
  mutate(fill_rate = n_with_business_name / n_ein_records) |>
  left_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  filter(payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids) |>
  filter(!is.na(fill_rate)) |>
  arrange(fill_rate) |>
  mutate(
    no_name_pct = 1 - fill_rate,
    payer_name = fct_reorder(payer_name, row_number())
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fill_rate, no_name_pct),
    values_to = "pct",
    names_to = "type"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = c("fill_rate", "no_name_pct")),
    type = fct_rev(fct_relabel(type, \(x) {
      replace_values(
        x,
        "fill_rate" ~ "Has <span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>",
        "no_name_pct" ~ "No <span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>"
      )
    }))
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      fill = type
    ),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "No <span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>" = "#fc8d62",
      "Has <span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>" = "#66c2a5"
    )
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "", reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Most large payers are populating TiC 2.0's ",
      "<span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Share of EIN records with a non-empty ",
      "<span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span> value ",
      "in Mar. 2026 files"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files"
    ),
    y = "",
    x = paste0(
      "Percent of payer EIN records"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 19,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -140)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -140),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12, b = 4, r = -15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey40"),
```

```{r plt_ein_overlap_by_payer}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

ein_names_overlap_mar |>
  left_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  select(-new_ein_names, -payer_lives) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(existing_ein_names, starts_with("npi_type")),
    names_to = "ein_type",
    values_to = "record_count"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ein_type = fct_rev(factor(
      ein_type,
      levels = c(
        "existing_ein_names",
        "npi_type_2_only",
        "npi_type_1_only",
        "npi_type_mixed",
        "npi_type_unknown"
      )
    )),
    ein_type = fct_relabel(
      ein_type,
      \(x) {
        replace_values(
          x,
          "npi_type_2_only" ~ "Type 2 NPI only",
          "npi_type_1_only" ~ "Type 1 NPI only",
          "npi_type_mixed" ~ "Mixed NPI types",
          "npi_type_unknown" ~ "Unknown NPI types"
        )
      }
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    existing_ein_count = record_count[ein_type == "existing_ein_names"],
    pct = record_count / existing_ein_count,
    .by = "payer_name"
  ) |>
  filter(ein_type != "existing_ein_names") |>
  mutate(
    total_pct = sum(pct),
    total_cnt = sum(record_count),
    .by = "payer_name"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = paste0(
      "**",
      payer_name,
      "**<br>",
      label_comma()(existing_ein_count)
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(payer_name = fct_reorder(payer_name, total_pct)) |>
  mutate(total_fmt = paste0("+", label_comma()(total_cnt))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      fill = ein_type
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = total_pct,
      y = payer_name,
      label = total_fmt
    ),
    color = "grey30",
    hjust = -0.1,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "richtext",
    x = 1.33,
    y = 1.5,
    label = paste0(
      "Ambetter had ~75K EIN<br>names ",
      "tracked by Turquoise<br><br>",
      "<span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>",
      " added 41K more,<br>",
      "but mostly related to Type 1 NPIs"
    ),
    hjust = 1,
    label.color = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 0.675,
    xend = 0.63,
    y = 1.1,
    yend = 1.75,
    curvature = -0.3,
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Percent increase from count of existing EINs",
    labels = label_percent(),
    expand = expansion(c(0, 0.10)),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c(
      "Type 2 NPI only" = "#66c2a5",
      "Type 1 NPI only" = "#fc8d62",
      "Mixed NPI types" = "#e78ac3",
      "Unknown NPI types" = "#d14749"
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.25), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Payers added new EIN names via TiC 2.0's ",
      "<span style='font-family:mono'>business_name</span>"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "However, most of the new names are for ",
      "individuals (Type 1 NPIs), not businesses"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files"
    ),
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 19,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -158)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -158),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12, b = 4, r = -15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      vjust = 0.4
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.text.x.top = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box.margin = margin(b = -6, l = -152),
    legend.margin = margin(l = -10, r = 8, t = 6, b = 6),
    legend.text = element_markdown(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 20)
    ),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "grey20"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = -20, r = 20, t = 6)
  )
```

```{r tbl_ein_sample_names}
#| column: page

ein_names_common_mar |>
  select(-payer_name) |>
  right_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = str_trunc(payer_name, 40),
    business_name_value = map_chr(
      business_name_value,
      \(x) paste(str_trunc(x[1:3], 50), collapse = ", ")
    ),
    business_name_n_uniq = replace_na(business_name_n_uniq, 0),
    business_name_value = replace_values(
      business_name_value,
      NA ~ "No business names posted",
      "" ~ "No business names posted"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(payer_name) |>
  select(
    `Payer name` = payer_name,
    `# of unique bus. names` = business_name_n_uniq,
    `Top 3 most common business names by record count` = business_name_value
  ) |>
  write_csv("data/publish/tbl_bn_cnt_top.csv")
```
